# sqlpipe v2.0

sqlpipe v2.0 changes the `/v2/users` response, adds incremental processing, and improves Parquet write performance.

## Breaking change

BREAKING CHANGE: Before you use `/v2/users` with version 2.0, update clients to read `first_name` and `last_name`.

The endpoint no longer returns the `name` field. Clients that require `name` will fail to read user names. The new fields provide the first and last name as separate values.

## Incremental processing

Use the new `--incremental` flag to process only data that changed after the previous run.

This flag reduces repeated work for pipelines with frequent updates.

## Parquet performance

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in sqlpipe v1.x. This improvement reduces write time for large data sets. Actual performance depends on the data, storage, and system resources.
